interface.longDescription: Android-first OMEGA engineering operating system for ChatGPT mobile with a shared Cloud Run-ready Streamable HTTP MCP backend for ChatGPT and Gemini. The remote gateway is an OAuth 2.1 resource server with RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata, OIDC/JWKS or RFC 7662 token verification, Cloud Run health/readiness endpoints, and the same OMEGA control-plane tools used by the local runtime. Existing Google Cloud organization/folder/project automation, Gemini/Vertex AI, IBM Cloud/watsonx, GitHub/GitLab, Unity, Google Play, web/mobile E2E and code-lifecycle squads remain intact. The existing OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel to Termux is preserved as an additional local/device executor rather than replaced.
defaultPrompt: Use OMEGA Mobile v4.3 as an end-to-end product engineering fabric from ChatGPT on Android; prefer the authenticated Remote MCP gateway for shared cloud execution and use the Termux Secure MCP lane when local/device execution is materially useful.
For Gemini, expose the same HTTPS /mcp endpoint and OAuth resource server; never assume Gemini custom-app availability until the client actually connects and authenticates.
Preserve branches, credentials and existing provider integrations; verify every tool, build, deployment, artifact and release with provider-native evidence and never fabricate success.

name: omega-omni-cognitive-engineering-mobile
description: Android-first OMEGA engineering OS for ChatGPT mobile with 171 coordinated agent skills, including 68 AAA Android game specialists, 30 native Android E2E specialists, 30 web/full-stack E2E specialists, 10 code-lifecycle agents, 21 core control-plane agents, and a 12-agent multi-cloud/runtime fabric spanning OpenAI, Gemini/Vertex AI, organization-wide Google Cloud automation, IBM Cloud/watsonx, a Cloud Run-ready OAuth-protected Remote MCP gateway, and the preserved Termux Secure MCP lane.
